description: Cards that belong in a commander deck (id or name; Commander, Duel Commander or Pauper Commander, with its commander set), in two lists titled by `title` ("For <commander>"; never call them recommendations). `played_with`: what the commander's tournament lists play, most played first — `share` 0–1 of its lists play the card, `share_elsewhere` of the format's other lists (a card far above its share elsewhere is this commander's own). Whenever you mention these counts, credit every source in `sources` by name with its link (TopDeck.gg always), and when `cedh` is true say they are cEDH tournament lists, not casual decks; `note` says it in one sentence. `known` false: under 10 lists a year, no counts. `on_theme`: the cards nearest the commander's rules text in its colours (`closeness` 0–1, not a verdict), for every commander, without the cards `played_with` holds. They are cards LIKE the commander — goblin makers for a goblin maker — and miss cards that work WITH it (the instants a spell-trigger commander wants): YOU judge which fit, and say so. Both lists are fitted to the deck: in its colour identity, legal in its format, not already in it; `owned` = the user's cards with free copies, `to_buy` = cheapest priced non-foil printing in `currency` (default USD), null when none is priced yet (the nightly price refresh prices it; `price_queued` is always false and `prices_queued` 0). Say `proxies` beside a card that has any, name every deck in `shared_with` (those copies are borrowed), and name the decks in `claimed_by` when `owned_claimed` > 0. `limit` per list and side, default 10, max 30. Read-only: it changes nothing and starts no work.

currency.description: Display currency. USD/EUR come from Scryfall; CHF is always EUR × the stored ECB rate. A response that carries `rate_missing` could not price in CHF at all: tell the user that, not that the cards have no price.
